public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Mazama is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Sriram Vasantharajan, having raised $30M+ to date. The valuation analysis considers a peer universe of 9 companies in the Climate & Energy sector (1 public, 8 private), including comparable-stage or thematic peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using the $30M total raised as a valuation proxy, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progressions yields an implied valuation of $60M. The peer-median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow filter; while 8 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 fell within relevant valuation tiers or stage proximity required for reliable median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median of $60M. This range reflects the single-method foundation and the inherent uncertainty in frontier-tech stage-progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of sector-wide Series A multiples given climate-tech capital volatility, the specificity of Mazama's product and market position relative to the broader peer set, and potential variance from typical step-up multiples if follow-on investor appetite diverges from historical norms.
